source_gap_claims.behavior: A stable subject must have verifiable provenance for source-supported existing behavior, and the Candidate must contain the real change under evaluation.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require immutable Stable and Candidate executions but do not require Stable provenance or that Candidate contain the actual evaluated change.
source_gap_claims.subject: Stable and Candidate eligibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: The detached positive Probe must pass, and the detached negative Probe must fail for its declared defect and expected diagnostic category.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require detached processes and reject always-success and infrastructure-failure false negatives, but do not require the positive-pass and declared-defect/expected-diagnostic outcomes.
source_gap_claims.subject: Probe oracle outcomes

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each Probe must independently bind its input, actual target, command, result, and output evidence; an invalid-package Matrix Case cannot substitute for this oracle.
source_gap_claims.reason: The Probe obligations require bound inputs and outputs but omit actual-target, command, and result bindings and the non-substitution rule.
source_gap_claims.subject: Probe evidence binding

source_gap_claims.behavior: All six named Matrix semantic distinctions—valid package, invalid package, historical compatibility, dirty baseline, knowledge read-set collision, and closed-policy architecture-index gap—must be exercised.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require six materially distinct cases but do not require these six specific semantic cases.
source_gap_claims.subject: Closed Matrix Case set

source_gap_claims.behavior: An expected-difference result is allowed only when frozen for that Matrix Case and all execution and evidence gates pass, and it cannot approve a regression.
source_gap_claims.reason: The terminal-category obligation limits where expected-difference may occur but does not require its frozen case expectation, all gates, or non-regression behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Matrix expected-difference handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each Consumer must bind its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require real Consumer calls and route restoration, but do not require this complete per-Consumer binding.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer execution identity

source_gap_claims.behavior: Disable and rollback must each invoke the Prior Route and reproduce its identity, verdict, and diagnostic category for every applicable fixture; configuration-only state changes do not qualify.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require real transition calls and aggregate restoration but do not independently represent the Prior-Route and per-fixture postconditions for disable and rollback.
source_gap_claims.subject: Disable and rollback route semantics

source_gap_claims.behavior: Every behavioral duty requires an independent fault witness and every non-behavioral duty a deterministic violation witness.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require Exact Cover and witnesses generally, but do not impose the distinct witness-type rule.
source_gap_claims.subject: Exact Cover witness requirements

source_gap_claims.behavior: Existing passing brownfield behavior requires truthful characterization and a distinct fault witness before production behavior changes; fabricated RED or post-hoc failure evidence is invalid.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires defect-revealing tests before production changes or rejects fabricated/post-hoc failure evidence.
source_gap_claims.subject: Defect-revealing test discipline

source_gap_claims.behavior: Writes to installed BMAD/GDS paths and Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, and sandbox paths are rejected.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation represents the protected-path and service/sandbox write boundaries.
source_gap_claims.subject: Protected write boundaries

source_gap_claims.behavior: TC-D1 must reject TC-E0/D2-D6 work, quality-baseline or evaluation-set admission, promotion, Miner/Curator, autonomous modification, ranking, and reinforcement-learning scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations constrain seed classification and replacement trees but do not represent the broader roadmap and feature-scope prohibitions.
source_gap_claims.subject: TC-D1 roadmap and feature boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: A current equivalent replay of historical evidence must create new process evidence and state its equivalence boundary.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations preserve historical evidence and require fresh replay, but do not require an explicit equivalence-boundary statement for a current equivalent replay.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical equivalent replay

source_gap_claims.behavior: Only the current Acceptance lifecycle owner may publish acceptance-passed after required independent review and scoped approval.
source_gap_claims.reason: The publication-authorization obligation restricts the publisher but omits the required independent-review and scoped-approval preconditions.
source_gap_claims.subject: Acceptance-passed publication preconditions
